builds.name: Reference: Physical pick
builds.goal: Reference for Zed: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A shadow-based assassin who lines up overlapping shurikens, uses swaps for positioning and concentrates damage inside Death Mark's timed window. Record shadow placement, overlapping shuriken hits and actual Death Mark window damage. Mark repeats eligible recorded damage, not every hypothetical item/proc in the build. Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Zed: Record shadow placement, overlapping shuriken hits and actual Death Mark window damage. Mark repeats eligible recorded damage, not every hypothetical item/proc in the build.

Start with the early core (Youmuu, then Profane Hydra) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Lethality, approach speed and armor penetration favor short physical pick windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.

Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
